mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS registrationId, n.id AS newsId, n.title AS newsTitle, u.id AS userId, u.username AS username, u.nickname AS nickname, r.create_time AS registrationTime FROM registration r LEFT JOIN news n ON r.news_id = n.id LEFT JOIN "user" u ON r.user_id = u.id ORDER BY n.id, r.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS totalStudents, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(points, 0))::numeric, 2), 0) AS averageScore FROM "user" WHERE role = 0

SELECT ws.quiz_id AS quizId, q.question AS question, COUNT(*)::int AS wrongCount, COALESCE(ROUND((COUNT(*) * 100.0 / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wrong_set), 0))::numeric, 2), 0) AS wrongRate FROM wrong_set ws LEFT JOIN quiz q ON ws.quiz_id = q.id GROUP BY ws.quiz_id, q.question ORDER BY wrongCount DESC LIMIT 5
